scripts.lect-effect/self:build: pnpm run lect-effect/self:clean && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json
scripts.lect-effect/build: pnpm -C packages/domain build && pnpm -C apps/backend build && pnpm -C packages/graphql-schema build && pnpm -C packages/graphql-schema schema:generate && pnpm -C apps/frontend build && pnpm -C docs build
scripts.lect-effect/clean: pnpm -C packages/domain clean && pnpm -C apps/backend clean && pnpm -C packages/graphql-schema clean && pnpm -C apps/frontend clean && pnpm -C docs clean
scripts.lect-effect/docs:generate: pnpm -C apps/backend docs:generate && pnpm -C apps/frontend docs:generate && pnpm -C packages/domain docs:generate && pnpm -C packages/graphql-schema docs:generate
scripts.lect-effect/migrate/masterdata:up: env-cmd -f .env --no-override node-pg-migrate --migration-filename-format utc -d MASTERDATA_PG_URL -m apps/backend/migrations/masterdatadb up
scripts.lect-effect/migrate/test-masterdata:up: env-cmd -f .env.test --no-override node-pg-migrate --migration-filename-format utc -d TEST_MASTERDATA_PG_URL -m apps/backend/migrations/masterdatadb up
scripts.lect-effect/start: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "pnpm -C apps/backend start" "pnpm -C apps/frontend start"
scripts.lect-effect/start:with-docs: concurrently --names backend,frontend,docs --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "pnpm -C apps/backend start" "pnpm -C apps/frontend start" "pnpm -C docs dev"
scripts.lect-effect/test: pnpm -C packages/domain test && pnpm -C apps/backend test && pnpm -C apps/frontend test
